note: Written by hand from leaks.json (python -m tools.masking_leaks --write); every leak is held by an xfail case of tests/unit/test_masking_leaks.py. Rates are per 1,000 planted notes and weigh every planted form the same.

findings.claim: Japanese names leak 767 per 1,000; after 氏名 katakana, hiragana and Hepburn names leak every time, 殿 905 per 1,000
English names leak 546 per 1,000; LAST, First and initials leak after Name: every time
Chinese names leak 476 per 1,000; Pinyin names after 姓名 every time, and Han names with a surname outside the masker's list
The Japanese insurance card's 記号・番号 leaks after its label every time
An e-mail address with a full-width ＠ is never masked, in all three languages
Unlabelled Taiwan landlines and full-width Taiwan and Japan mobiles leak 714 per 1,000
A line break inside a value defeats every recogniser: 680 to 753 per 1,000 at that place
A compact 7-digit ROC birth date before 出生 is never masked
An unlabelled US SSN leaks 714 per 1,000 (the masker has no unlabelled SSN shape)
The gateway tripwire misses 246 per 1,000 planted notes, so those raw notes may take a route that leaves the box
Every 8-digit clinical date is masked in chunks and trips the tripwire (site pattern ^\d{8}$); the screening effect (retrieval, S2b from stored vectors) is a hypothesis, no exclusion path shown
findings.ruling: D-337 section 4: the judge reads the original note

findings.claim: An English address whose house number reads as a year (1900 to 2099) is not masked at all
